info.title: MediConnect API
info.description: REST API shared by the MediConnect website and (Phase 14+) Flutter mobile app. Generated from the same zod validation schemas that run at request time — see scripts/generate-openapi.ts. Every authenticated route takes a bearer access token obtained from /auth/login or /auth/refresh. For the website, the refresh token travels only as an HttpOnly cookie scoped to /api/v1/auth, never in a JSON body. A native app has no cookie jar, so sending the header `X-Client-Platform: mobile` on /auth/login and /auth/refresh additionally returns the raw refresh token in the JSON body (store it in platform secure storage, e.g. Keychain/Keystore — never plain storage); /auth/refresh and /auth/logout then also accept `{ "refreshToken": "..." }` in the body as a fallback when no cookie is present. CORS (CORS_ORIGIN) only restricts browser-based callers — it has no effect on a native mobile app's HTTP requests, which are never subject to the same-origin policy a browser enforces.
